method: For each sample, use its timeDelta as weight. Self belongs to the leaf; inclusive is counted once per distinct function+URL in that sample, with anonymous closures separated by transformed position. Categories assign the sample to its deepest recognized owner. Inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed; category rows partition all weights.
caveats: Vite-transformed callFrame locations are not original TypeScript line numbers.
Sampled CPU weight is not exact function duration or call count. Native Intl/JSON work can be charged to the JS caller.
GC and incomplete stacks are left unallocated. No allocation count, native Intl construction/format split, or causal speedup is measured.
Only the existing one-shot capture is read. No fixture, test or product code is executed by this analysis.
Diagnostic timing is not formal threshold evidence; original cold FAIL and remaining NOT VERIFIED stay binding.
